text:
George Hirst scored both goals as Stoke secured a fifth successive Championship win by beating Millwall 2-1 to go level on points with Middlesbrough at the top.
The Scotland international scored his second goal for the Potters in the 1-0 win over Birmingham on Saturday and doubled his tally for the season to take Stoke back into the automatic promotion places.
Mark Sykes’s stunning strike halved the deficit in the final 10 minutes, but Stoke held on to claim an 11th win in their past 14 outings. The defeat was Millwall’s fourth in a row, coming a day after it was announced they had been ordered to play a future match in front of a partially closed stadium for offensive chanting.
“There’s been a little bit said about George that is unfair,” said the Stoke manager, Mark Robins. “It’s amazing if you just remember that you love playing football and you just go and do it, everything else tends to fall into place. It’s not as simple as that but it really helps, and he’s done that.”
Burnley set a new record for the longest home run without a league win as Birmingham reaffirmed their promotion credentials with a 2-0 victory at Turf Moor thanks to August Priske’s strike and Jaydon Banel’s own goal.
It is now 24 games since Burnley last earned three points in front of their own fans, a nightmare run that has now stretched to 403 days. It represents the worst sequence in the history of English football.
Burnley, relegated from the Premier League last season, remain in the drop zone, one point above the bottom side Derby. Fabio Celestini has picked up three points in the five games he has taken charge of since succeeding Nicky Hayen last month and his team were jeered off at the end. For Birmingham, it was a timely return to form after a 1-0 defeat at Stoke. Chris Davies’s team are two places and two points off the automatic promotion spots.
Watford’s new head coach, Edward Iordanescu, watched from the stands as Todd Cantwell’s penalty condemned the struggling hosts to a 1-0 defeat by resilient Blackburn. The former Romania national team manager, who had just flown in after signing a contract, was introduced to a sparsely populated Vicarage Road to polite applause, 10 minutes before kick-off.
On the evidence of Watford’s third home defeat of the season, he will have his work cut out to steer them away from the Championship’s relegation quicksands.
The Norwegian duo Aune Heggebø and Felix Horn Myhre scored the goals as West Brom boosted their promotion push with a 3-1 win at Bolton. Heggebø gave James Morrison’s in-form visitors the lead which was cancelled out by Ruben Rodrigues’s second-half penalty.
But West Brom, without their injured top scorer Isaac Price, finished strongly, with Myhre’s fifth goal since his summer move from Brann restoring West Brom’s lead after 75 minutes. Heggebø, back in the starting lineup after Saturday’s draw with Swansea, sealed a fifth win in eight games with a penalty.
“I thought [Heggebø] would be perfect for this game if we could get behind their high back line,” said Morrison. On Price’s absence, the West Brom manager added: “Any team would miss big players and what they bring to the team. But it’s not to cry about, it is about trying to find the best way and trust in the players who come in.”

סטוק סידרה לעצמה מקום בצמרת הגבוהה של ליגת הצ'מפיונשיפ לאחר ניצחון 1-2 על מילוול, הודות לצמד שערים של ג'ורג' הירסט שהעניק לקבוצה את ניצחונה החמישי ברציפות. מנגד, בורנלי שקעה עוד יותר כאשר קבעה שיא שלילי חדש באנגליה של 24 משחקי בית רצופים ללא ניצחון, לאחר הפסד ביתי נוסף לברימינגהאם.

במשחקים נוספים שנערכו בליגה, וסט ברומיץ' גברה 1-3 בחוץ על בולטון בזכות שערים של אאונה הפגבו ופליקס הורן מיהרה, מה שחיזק את מאבקי העלייה שלה. במקביל, ווטפורד הפסידה לבלקברן במשחק הבכורה של המאמן החדש אדוארד יורדאנסקו שצפה מהיציע.
